hero.kicker: A community food larder in Callowford
hero.title: Nobody on our streets should go to bed hungry
hero.text: We hand out food, toiletries and a hot drink to anyone who needs them, three days a week, no questions asked.
hero.text2: Linden Row Larder is run by neighbours, for neighbours. Everything on our shelves was given by someone living nearby.
hero.note: No referral needed. Just come to the hall.

statement.title: Food first, and a friendly face
statement.text: Most people who come to us need food for a week. Many also need someone to talk to about rent, bills or work, and we know who can help.

steps.title: How to get help
steps.text: There is no form to fill in before you come.

items.title: Come to the hall
items.text: Tuesday, Thursday or Saturday morning, at St Aldo's Hall on Linden Row.

items.title: Have a cup of tea
items.text: A volunteer sits with you and asks what you need this week.

items.title: Take a parcel home
items.text: Food for three days for everyone in your home, and toiletries if you need them.

items.d: A money adviser comes every Thursday.
Nappies, wipes and formula on request.
Packed lunches for children in every holiday.
For people who cannot come to the hall.

catalogue.title: Ways to help
catalogue.text: Food, time or money: each keeps the shelves full.
catalogue.note: We are a registered charity; gifts of money can be made with tax relief.

groups.text: Bring it to the hall on an open morning or to a collection box.

items.name: Toiletries
items.text: Toothpaste, soap, shampoo and sanitary products.

groups.text: Two hours a week makes a difference.

items.name: Van driver
items.text: Collecting from supermarkets and delivering to homes.

groups.text: Money buys what nobody gives: fresh milk, bread and nappies.

plans.title: Give every month
plans.text: A monthly gift lets us plan what to buy.

items.name: Friend
items.line: Milk for a family for a month.

items.name: Neighbour
items.line: A family parcel every two months.

team.title: Who runs the larder
